Quiz: The Baptism of Jesus Story Quiz
Question: Why did John protest when Jesus came to be baptized?
OptionA: He said the river was too shallow
OptionB: He said Jesus was too young
OptionC: He said only priests could baptize
OptionD: He said he needed Jesus to baptize him
Explanation: John protested because he felt he needed Jesus to baptize him, not the other way around.
